rationale: Package-level mutable variables `Aval` and `Bval` (L5-L6) are modified in the `invoke()` transaction function (L33-L34) without being reinitialized per transaction. These globals retain state across multiple invocations, causing different endorsers to compute divergent values depending on prior transaction history, violating consensus determinism. The `Init()` function initializes these globals once, but subsequent `Invoke()` calls mutate them persistently, creating endorsement divergence.
